result.result:
I found two inconsistencies that would break code calling carriers through the registry. I diffed all 20 carrier modules against `acme.py`. Apart from these two, every carrier has the same interface and only its rate numbers and TODO owner differ.

### 1. `shop/carriers/maple.py` takes weight in grams, not kg
The docstring says "weight in grams", and the module defines `PER_GRAMS = 3` and `MAX_GRAMS = 30000` where every other carrier has `PER_KG` and `MAX_KG`. `rate(weight, zone)` keeps the same signature, so nothing fails loudly, but a caller passing kg like it does for the other 19 carriers gets wrong results:
- `get("maple").rate(2.0)` treats the 2.0 as 2 grams. It returns `int(494 + 3*2) = 500` cents, about half of what 2 kg should cost.
- The weight limit doesn't work for kg input: anything up to 30000 "kg" is accepted.
- Code that compares quotes across carriers (e.g. picking the cheapest) will nearly always pick maple wrongly.

### 2. `delta.py`, `kestrel.py`, `onyx.py` and `tundra.py` have no `tracking_url()`
The other 16 carriers define `tracking_url(self, code) -> str`. These four end after `valid_label`, so `get("delta").tracking_url(code)` (and the same call on the other three) raises `AttributeError`. Nothing in `shop/carriers/__init__.py` enforces a shared interface, so this only shows up when the code runs.

### Not breaking, for completeness
- Each carrier has its own `ZONES` multipliers, `BASE_RATE`, per-unit rate and weight limit. All use the same zone keys (`local`, `regional`, `national`), so zone lookups work everywhere.
- The `TODO(owner-N)` header comments differ, which is harmless.

Nothing outside `shop/carriers/` in this repo calls the registry. The breakage would hit callers outside this repo or code added later. I didn't edit any files.
